name: std/io
description: Reads and writes text through standard streams and open files.
readme: Reads and writes text through standard streams and open files.
Import this module with use io.

files.content:
-- Reads and writes text through standard streams and open files.
public define Stream as opaque.
public use "io" function input() of type pointer to Stream.
public use "io" function output() of type pointer to Stream.
public use "io" function report() of type pointer to Stream.
public use "io" function read(stream of type pointer to Stream, size of type unsigned 64) of type fallible text.
public use "io" function line(stream of type pointer to Stream) of type fallible text.
public use "io" function write(stream of type pointer to Stream, content of type text) of type fallible nothing.
public use "io" function close(stream of type pointer to Stream) of type fallible nothing.
public function display(content text) giving fallible nothing { try write(output(), content). give. }
public function show(content text) giving nothing { write(output(), content) fallback nothing. }
